frontend.title: 🌐 Frontend Developer Roadmap
frontend.description:
Step-by-step guide to becoming a Frontend Developer:

**Step 1: The Basics**
- HTML5 (Semantic HTML, Accessibility)
- CSS3 (Flexbox, Grid, Responsive Design)
- JavaScript (ES6+, DOM Manipulation, Fetch API/AJAX)

**Step 2: Build Tools & Git**
- Version Control (Git, GitHub)
- Package Managers (npm, yarn)
- Bundlers (Vite, Webpack)

**Step 3: Frameworks/Libraries**
- React.js (Hooks, Context, State Management like Redux/Zustand)
- Next.js (SSR, SSG, Routing)

**Step 4: Styling & UI**
- Tailwind CSS
- Material UI or Chakra UI

**Step 5: Advanced Topics**
- TypeScript
- Testing (Jest, Cypress, React Testing Library)
- Performance Optimization (Lighthouse, Lazy Loading)

backend.title: ⚙️ Backend Developer Roadmap
backend.description:
Step-by-step guide to becoming a Backend Developer:

**Step 1: Core Fundamentals**
- Choose a Language (Node.js/Python/Java/Go)
- Learn APIs (REST, GraphQL, gRPC)
- HTTP Basics & Networking

**Step 2: Database Management**
- Relational: PostgreSQL, MySQL
- NoSQL: MongoDB, Redis
- ORMs/ODMs (Mongoose, Prisma, Sequelize) 

**Step 3: Server & Frameworks**
- Express.js or NestJS (for Node)
- Django or FastAPI (for Python)
- Spring Boot (for Java)

**Step 4: Advanced Concepts**
- Authentication (JWT, OAuth, Sessions)
- Caching (Redis)
- Message Brokers (RabbitMQ, Kafka)
- Microservices Architecture

**Step 5: Deployment & DevOps**
- Docker & Containers
- CI/CD Pipelines (GitHub Actions)
- Cloud Providers (AWS, GCP)

dsa.title: 🧠 DSA & Interview Prep Roadmap
dsa.description:
Step-by-step guide for cracking technical interviews:

**Phase 1: Basic Foundations**
- Time & Space Complexity (Big O Notation)
- Arrays & Strings (Two pointers, Sliding Window)
- Hashing (HashMap, HashSet)

**Phase 2: Linear Data Structures**
- Linked Lists (Reversal, Cycle Detection)
- Stacks & Queues (Monotonic stack)

**Phase 3: Trees & Graphs**
- Binary Trees (DFS, BFS, Traversals)
- Binary Search Trees (BST)
- Graph Traversal (DFS, BFS, Topological Sort)

**Phase 4: Advanced Algorithms**
- Dynamic Programming (Memoization, Tabulation)
- Greedy Algorithms
- Backtracking
- Tries & Union Find

**Phase 5: Mock Interviews & CP**
- Leetcode Top 150 / Blind 75
- Participate in Codeforces/Codechef div 2/3/4
- System Design Basics (for SDE-2+ roles)
